description: Water Abhishek Pooja is the simplest and most sacred way to receive Lord Shiva's grace.
procedure: Use of Narmada river water or other sacred water.
Offer water on Shivling with mantras.

description: A ritual performed to remove the negative effects of planets and attain peace.
procedure: Chanting mantras to calm the malefic effects of planets.

description: A powerful remedy to defeat enemies and overcome difficulties through the worship of Mata Baglamukhi.

procedure: Chanting mantras to remove marriage obstacles.

description: A ritual dedicated to honoring and expressing gratitude to the Guru.
procedure: Offering respect at the Guru's feet.
